### Premise re-verified on `origin/main` = `e7084269`, ⛔ not taken from the card

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx:419` forwards `scope={scope}` and **no `roots`** ⇒ the mount takes the engine's default root list for that scope. Premise confirmed.
- The in-tree precedent is real: `ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS` is declared at `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ConditionalFormattingEditor.tsx:97`, and its sibling test asserts `expect(ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS).not.toContain('app')` — a pin that goes red if the list regains an unbound root.

Timeline read for an already-merged delivery: **no cross-referenced PR at all**.

⚠️ **A conflation hazard this seat found while verifying, which the card does not name.** `ConditionBuilder.tsx` ALREADY carries a roots concept of its own at `:104-130` — 「Scope roots a value typed into the value box may plainly REFERENCE」 — with its own commentary about `app` being 「a root at ... produce another silently-false predicate instead of a loud one」. That list serves the **value box**, not the CEL editor's autocomplete. ⇒ these are two different populations in one file and ⛔ they must not be merged into one list on the assumption that they are the same thing. Named in the dispatch as a mechanism assumption.

### Clause-② `no`

Narrowing which roots the autocomplete advertises **removes** suggestions; it accepts strictly less and publishes no new symbol. The server's binding is untouched, so no runtime permission or security behaviour moves either — this is the negative boundary, not clause ②. ⚠️ Reviewer's hook: if the delivered diff widens what the editor accepts, or exports a new symbol from a published entry point, this `no` is void.

## **ACCEPT** — PR objectui#9854, reviewed against GitHub at 2026-09-18T10:40Z

`domain:ui` seat 3 (session `session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn`, `Seat: domain:ui#3`). Reviewed against the PR's real diff, file list and check roster, plus this seat's own re-measurement. `Implemented-by:` the dev on claim `5728379952`; `Reviewed-by:` this seat.

### Checklist conclusion

| item | reading |
|---|---|
| PR shape | draft ✅, base `main` ✅, first body line exactly `Fixes #9645` ✅ |
| Path surface | 3 files — `ConditionBuilder.tsx`, a new sibling test in the same directory, one `.changeset/`. Fence unbreached |
| Governed face | **NONE** ⇒ ordinary merge-queue path |
| CI on head `f65380b3` | 25 success · 3 skipped · **0 non-success**, 8 still `in_progress` at review time — ⛔ not read as green |
| `mcp_calls` | **0**; `api_writes` **2**. No deny-roster tool |

### Clause-② `no` — verified, with a lit control

This diff turns two constants into exports (`REFERENCE_ROOTS`, and the new `RECORD_CONDITION_ROOTS`), which is the one thing that could have voided the declaration. **It does not reach a published face.** Measured on `origin/main`: `packages/app-shell`'s `exports` map carries exactly one entry, `"."` → `dist/index.js`; `src/index.ts` (470 lines, 84 `export` lines — the lit control, so the absence below is real) re-exports neither symbol, and its only mention of `inspectors` is a comment recording that objectui#6776 **deliberately moved them out of the barrel**. The sole in-repo importer of `ConditionBuilder` is a sibling panel. ⇒ both symbols stay package-internal and `@object-ui/app-shell`'s published face is unchanged.

### The hazard this seat fenced — answered by measurement, not by assurance

The dispatch's Zone 2 item 1 warned that this file already carries a **different** roots population (`REFERENCE_ROOTS`, for the value box) and that merging it with the autocomplete list would be the obvious wrong move. The dev proved them non-coincident rather than asserting it: `REFERENCE_ROOTS` carries `org` and `parent`, and `introspectScope('record')` advertises neither — and measured on the installed engine, `org.id == 'o1'` is a **hard lint ERROR** at record scope with the nonsense remedy 「Write `record.org`」. ⇒ reusing the value-box list as the advertised list would have re-created the objectui#8155 `app` failure one component over. Both lists now carry a docblock naming the question each answers, and a case in the new suite — derived from the engine rather than copied from either list — reddens if anyone merges them.

### Two things reasoned out that the dispatch did not specify

- **Why the list cannot be derived per mount.** Nothing a mount passes distinguishes a SERVER-evaluated `condition` from a CLIENT-evaluated `visible`, and their hosts bind different sets — app-shell's `buildExpressionScope` publishes `current_user` / `user` / `ctx` / `os` / `features` to the client evaluator, while objectstack's hook wrapper binds `{ record, previous }`. So no single hardcoded list is truthful at every mount; hence a default **plus** a caller-supplied `roots` prop.
- **The asymmetry that picks the default's direction.** `roots` feeds autocomplete only — the accept set stays the engine's `SCOPE_ROOTS`. Over-advertising on a server mount costs the author **the write** (a throw); under-advertising costs a client mount **an offer**, never a spelling. Narrowing is therefore the safe direction, and the safe direction is the default.

It also found a closer precedent than the one this seat named: `ObjectFieldInspector`, in the same directory, already passes `roots={FIELD_RULE_ROOTS}` / `{FORMULA_ROOTS}` to `CelPredicateField` beside `scope='record'` — the mechanism reused rather than parallel-invented.

### The ablation, and an honest statement of what it does not prove

Mutating `roots={roots ?? (scope === 'record' ? RECORD_CONDITION_ROOTS : undefined)}` → `roots={roots}` turns the suite red: exit 1, **5 failures, all DOM-absence cases at the real `HookDefaultInspector` mount** (a hook condition no longer offering `os` / `current_user` / `user` / `vars` / `input`). Mutation and restore both proven by blob hash, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards. ⭐ And the report says plainly that **only those 5 flip** — the derived pins and the two controls read the advertised list and the engine rather than the forwarding, so they stay green under this ablation and fence a different drift. Stating what an ablation does *not* cover is the part usually left out.

### ⭐ An error of MINE the dev surfaced rather than silently absorbing

The dev reports: 「NO LABEL WRITE. The standing os-dev clause says to label the PR as soon as it opens; this dispatch says no label writes … I followed the dispatch and am naming the conflict rather than choosing silently.」 **That was the right call, and the conflict is mine.**

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` budgets four writes including `POST /issues/{n}/labels`, and states 「本仓库:标签是真实机制,打标签是你的步骤、不是 CI 的,PR 一开出就打」. My dispatch briefs wrote a blanket 「⛔ No label writes」. ⚠️ Read closely, that line's 「本仓库」 is **objectstack**, where the file lives, and the file carves objectui out separately two lines later — so the instruction was not flatly wrong. But my own protocol says 「无条件条款只住角色文件,冲突时它胜、错了修那里,⛔ 不靠派发词临时覆盖」: a role-file clause is not something a dispatch brief narrows on the fly. If objectui genuinely needs no dev label write, that belongs in `os-dev.md`, not in four of my briefs.

The substantive question is real and now measured four times over: **this PR carries `tests` and `package: app-shell`, applied by objectui's own `labeler.yml`, with the dev writing no label at all** — the same observation three devs have now made independently. Filed for the skills lane rather than settled here.

### Out-of-scope findings

Two are `to file` and this seat is filing both — ⭐ the first matters because **it means this card does not fully close its own trap**:

- The same file's `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS` offers `org.id` as a row **SUBJECT** at every mount, and record scope hard-errors on it with the nonsense remedy `record.org`; it also offers `user.*`, which no server-evaluated mount binds. ⇒ the hook trap this card closes in the **autocomplete** is still reachable through the **subject dropdown**. Correctly not folded in: repairing it changes what the row builder *emits*, a different control and a different blast radius.
- Client-evaluated mounts (an action's `visible` / `disabled`) now lose the `os` / `user` / `current_user` **offers** their host really binds until each declares `roots` — one line per mount, and the escape hatch is pinned by a case in the new suite rather than promised.

The two `noted, not filed` are correctly not filed: the two `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings are byte-identical to the pair `ConditionalFormattingEditor.tsx` already carries for `ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS` and the repo sets no `--max-warnings`; and `check:test-path-roots` printing 418 unclassified roots is that gate's own stated blind spot with nothing here depending on it.

### Landing

Path surface clean ⇒ ordinary **ready → merge queue** once every check is green or an expected skip. ⛔ Not flipped while 8 checks are `in_progress`. ⚠️ The auto-merge refusal recorded on PR objectui#9804 applies identically.
